There Is No “Falsetto Muscle.” でも、筋肉だけ見てもミックスボイスは分からない

“Chest voice = TA, falsetto = CT” is too simple. Starting from Ryoji Tanaka’s video, this essay separates anatomy, laryngeal register, subglottal pressure, glottal closure, and vocal-tract interaction. Narop has plausible connections to established source–filter and supraglottal-pressure research, but those connections are not the same as independent validation of the method itself. Mix is better understood as coordination under multiple constraints, not a third muscle.
